text: Implemented in fc1d7bc: explicit z=T(theta) and latent-group auxiliary equations; capability-selected primal-dual/ADMM/augmented-Lagrangian/conic descriptors; portable primal-dual L1/TV reference with KKT and primal-dual gap certificates; latent overlapping-group variables; aligned-score L1/group/Huber/bounded/equality targets; typed convergence, iteration-limit, numerical-failure, and infeasibility semantics; strict composite-lowering IR. Full gate: multivar JVM+JS 268/268, multivar-ir JVM 30 and JS 28.
